answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Scoring. Each identity logs per-epoch action summaries; enforce that its behavioural signature stays within a bounded distance across epochs—like a meadow whose species mix persists year to year. Deviations are scored, and persistent drift above threshold suspends the identity. An attacker farming sybils must maintain each puppet's long-run consistency, not just one burst, and cannot rotate fresh identities cheaply since new identities carry no history on the knoll of past epochs.
